name: Scattered Lapsus$ Hunters
description: Scattered Lapsus$ Hunters is a 2025 cybercrime alliance that claims to unite members of Scattered Spider, Lapsus$, and ShinyHunters into a single threat actor. The group emerged after criminal prosecutions weakened each of the component groups individually. Krebs on Security published a profile of 'Rey,' the group's self-identified administrator.
